Metadata.description: Private CRM for managing health insurance clients.

Login.hero: Your clients, policies and follow-ups in one place.
Login.heroSub: Medicare, Medicaid and ACA organized so you can answer every client quickly.
Login.title: Sign in
Login.subtitle: Use your user account.
Login.footer: For security, you are signed out after {minutes} minutes of inactivity.

reasons.expired: Your session reached its maximum length. Please sign in again.

Login.otpSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Login.backupSubtitle: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up verification.

Setup2FA.title: Set up two-step verification
Setup2FA.intro: It is required to protect client information. You need an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, etc.).
Setup2FA.scanHelp: Open your authenticator app and scan this code.
Setup2FA.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
Setup2FA.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
Setup2FA.backupHelp: Each code works once if you lose access to your app. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
Setup2FA.backupSaved: I saved my backup codes somewhere safe

Idle.title: Are you still there?
Idle.body: For security, your session will close in {seconds} seconds due to inactivity.

users.title: Users & links
users.subtitle: Link each assistant with the agents they support. The assistant sees and updates (contact and address) only the clients of their linked agents.
users.managementSoon: Creating users, changing roles and deactivating accounts arrives in the administration stage.
users.confirmBody: {assistant} will immediately stop seeing the clients of {agent}. The change is written to the audit log.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage users.
errors.invalid: That combination of users is not valid.

carriers.title: Carriers & programs
carriers.subtitle: Turn on the programs each carrier offers. Only active carriers with an active relationship appear when recording coverage.
carriers.noLinks: No relationships configured yet. No carrier will appear when recording coverage until you turn on at least one program.

rules.title: How it works
rules.r1: No relationship is assumed: you decide what each carrier offers.
rules.r2: You can add ACA-only carriers without mixing them with Medicare or Medicaid.
rules.r3: Deactivating a carrier or a relationship does not delete existing coverage; it just stops being offered for new records.
rules.r4: Every change is written to the audit log.
